neighbours.label: The preposition after a connecting verb: 'hook up to', 'plug into', 'connect to', 'tap into', 'wire into', as opposed to 'to'/'into' after verbs of motion or transfer
fire: The technician will hook your router up to the modem in the hall.
Our new app lets you plug into a network of local tutors.
The nurse connected the old man to a heart monitor.
These speakers tap into the same power line as the lamps.
Engineers wired the sensor into the main control board.
Ask the clerk, who can link you to the right department.
Мы подключили принтер к ноутбуку вчера вечером.
The adapter is attached to the back of the television.
quiet: The technician will drive your router over to the shop in town.
Our new app lets you look into a list of local tutors.
The nurse wheeled the old man to a waiting car.
These speakers came to the store in the same box as the lamps.
Engineers carried the sensor into the main storage room.
Ask the clerk, who can walk you to the right department.
Мы отнесли принтер к соседу вчера вечером.
The adapter was returned to the back of the warehouse.

notes: The shared pattern is physical or figurative connection. Probes: 0.2-0.97 after connecting verbs, under 0.02 after 'sent', 'moved', 'fell', 'flows'. Russian ' к' after подключить also fired, 0.68.
